name: mercury
title_zh: 双模型合流：一个 Agent 里同时跑 Hermes
tagline_zh: 不用在「会聊天」和「会推理」之间二选一。同一进程内让 Nous 的 Hermes 负责语言。
tagline_en: Stop choosing between chat and reasoning. Run Hermes for language and OMP for planning in one process—hard tasks.
desc_en: An AI agent hybrid distribution of Hermes by Nous Research and OMP by can1357
why_zh: 不是 API 拼盘，是真正的混合分发：按任务性质动态路由到对应模型，省去你手动切换的功夫。
why_en: Not an API mashup—true hybrid dispatch routes each subtask to the right model automatically, stabilizing long-horizon tasks.
limit_zh: 需要自行配置两个模型的权重与推理服务；若你的任务只需单一模型能力，混合层会带来额外延迟。不提供模型权重，只给分发框架。
limit_en: Requires you to host/configure both models' weights & inference. Pure single-model tasks pay extra routing latency. No weights included—only the.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: One agent, two brains: Hermes + OMP hybrid
